cases.name: toolbar opens a page-layer rounded menu with transparent corners and no native popup
synthetic page events cannot enable, save preferences, open settings or dismiss the menu
keyboard choices and site access persist; only explicit activation installs image controls
Close Escape outside click and the toolbar toggle dismiss without intercepting the page
page-origin messages cannot manage models or diagnostics and subframes cannot activate the menu
loading partial ready and unavailable state fixtures retain readable recovery controls
three widths zoom and opaque accessibility fallbacks keep the panel within the viewport
Settings and Privacy open only extension-owned pages; host consent is reviewed in Settings
cases.grantDialog: Manual; the test does not automatically grant host access.

cases.name: navigation removes the menu and restricted browser pages open Settings
strict CSP and Trusted Types do not block the floating menu or image controls

note: Real toolbar action opens the packaged page menu. Model-state variants are explicitly marked rendering fixtures. Opening/activation tests do not run OCR; real OCR/NLLB remains covered by test:overlays.
